sections.overview: This bromeliad frog is known from Santa Teresa, Brazil.
sections.identification: A 2015 study revised its diagnosis using adult specimens.
sections.habitat: It occupies bromeliads on rocky outcrops, in forests and gardens.
sections.diet: Its natural diet remains undescribed in the cited account.
sections.behavior: Males call from bromeliads on rainy nights.
sections.reproduction: Adults and tadpoles occur inside bromeliads.
sections.ecology: The 2015 study places it with S. alcatraz in the bromeliad-associated Scinax perpusillus group.
sections.conservation: The 2015 paper discusses local pressures but gives no current global status.
